title: Analysis & Findings
description: Source-linked analysis, including discrimination, one-vs-both, and conservative checklist.

rows.label: Normal local increase
rows.value: 1.6% or less on each eligible unit

rows.label: State cap is not a substitute
rows.value: AB 1482 8.8% does not apply to SF Rent Ordinance rent-controlled units

rows.label: Disparate-impact risk
rows.value: Liability can exist without intent; neutral criteria and no less discriminatory alternative matter

rows.label: FEHA broader classes
rows.value: Source of income, retaliation, perception/association and aggregate-income rules apply

rows.label: Unit 1 roommate change
rows.value: Not a basis for extra rent; vacancy-decontrol eligibility unverified

rows.label: One vs both
rows.value: Raising both is not officially required; identical neutral policy reduces disparate-treatment optics
rows.notes: Document neutral eligibility/anniversary reasons; no guarantee.

rows.label: Unit 2 long tenure
rows.value: Mere below-market rent is not extraordinary circumstances
rows.notes: Special Circumstances petition required for comparable-rent reset.

rows.label: Banked increases
rows.value: Cannot be inferred because rent history is unverified

rows.label: Corporate figures
rows.value: Portfolio-level disclosures are evidence of practice, not legal benchmarks

rows.label: Individual figures
rows.value: June 2024 workload is narrow formal-petition evidence

rows.label: Tenant-lawyer review
rows.value: Checklist capable of review; no approval claimed

rows.label: Conservative compliance checklist
rows.value: At most ordinary 1.6% annual allowable increase (or less) on each eligible unit, identical written neutral policy, license, notice, dates, calculations, recordkeeping

rows.label: Flagged items do not block
rows.value: All 34 flags published with source links
rows.notes: Needs review does not block merge.
